title: Fix the leaking default list
hints: Default values are evaluated **once**, when `def` runs, not on every call. Every call without `tags` gets the very same list object.
Use `None` as the default and create the fresh list **inside** the function body.
`def add_tag(tag: str, tags: list[str] | None = None) -> list[str]:` then `if tags is None: tags = []`, `tags.append(tag)`, `return tags`.
